Hi all — thanks again for joining the Lighthouse webinar today. We had a strong turnout and pulled the attendee export; attaching the canonical attendee CSV and a short clip-pack for the hot list. Quick summary and proposed next steps below.

TL;DR
- Attached: lighthouse-attendees-20280521.csv (full export) + lighthouse-high-priority-cliplist.pdf (top clips)
- Replay: https://s3.redwood-inference-hosting.com/lighthouse/recordings/20280521.mp4
- Please claim accounts for SDR demos by EOD Thursday (see routing matrix below)

Scoring (proposed automatic MQL mapping):
- Hot: watched >30 minutes OR joined live Q&A AND company size >=200 employees
- Warm: watched 10–30 minutes OR visited pricing/solutions pages within 72h
- Cold: registered but <10 minutes viewed and no site activity

Initial hot accounts (from quick pass):
- Acme Analytics (Susan Liu) — enterprise data team — HOT
- Meridian Health Data — HOT
- DataOps Co. (Jose Perez) — HOT

Routing matrix (proposal):
- Enterprise / HOT -> Marissa Cole (AE-led demos)
- Regional / Warm -> Tessa Morgan (SDR bookable slots)
- Inbound cold -> SDR pool (priority bucket 3) managed by Stephanie

Action items for internal team:
1) Marissa: confirm you'll take enterprise/hot accounts and flag any conflicts. Please list claimed accounts with HubSpot IDs.
2) Tessa: I'll need the SDR calendar window for next-week demo slots so we can include TTS booking in the outbound email.
3) Stephanie: sweep cold bucket for nurturing cadence and confirm follow-up templates.

Notes for ACME (Susan, Jose):
- We marked you HOT because of the Q&A and product-pages activity — Marissa will reach out to coordinate a tailored demo.
- If you prefer a technical deep-dive instead of the standard product demo, let us know and we’ll route to our solutions engineer.

Attachments: lighthouse-attendees-20280521.csv (CSV, 48KB); lighthouse-high-priority-cliplist.pdf (PDF, 2.2MB)

Thanks — I’ll reconcile claimed accounts on Friday and push the final HubSpot ownership updates before EOD.

Best,
Karthik
